splitRule: A case is held out when the first hex digit of sha256("factory-corpus@0:" + flow + "/" + id) is 0, 1 or 2.

roadmap-edits.published: not yet: graded only inside the factory in plumb-v1

direct-execution.published: not published: these cases are requests to the factory itself

tolerance.rule: Planner cases are graded on the exact expected operations (graders/grade.mjs). Tolerances apply to typed parameters where a flow compares parameter sets.
